claim_text: The Segal Report attributed to Gittam BBDO an intention to recruit the Arab sector to the anti-government protest using a clip that was actually from a different campaign.
discovery_sources: ICE contemporaneous report preserving Erel Segal correction
resolution_notes: Narrow False verdict: Segal himself corrected that the program mistakenly attributed the intention to Gittam and the clip came from a different campaign. Preserve that Segal called the error unintentional. No wider claim about Gittam or Channel 14 is inferred.
media_status: Exact original Channel 14 segment not recovered after C14 VOD/YouTube/web searches; no generic or illustrative imagery used. Notion published without preview; original-media gap remains Blocked.
